# Claude API

> > Comprehensive documentation for Anthropic's Claude API, covering Messages API, tool usage, vision capabilities, streaming responses, and prompt caching across multiple Claude models (Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.5, Opus 4.1).

Claude API by Anthropic provides developer documentation for integrating Claude's AI models into applications. The site covers core API features including the Messages endpoint, Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming, multimodal vision input, tool/function calling with JSON Schema, and prompt caching optimization techniques.

## Key Topics

- Messages API
- Claude Haiku 4.5
- Claude Sonnet 4.5
- Claude Opus 4.1
- Server-Sent Events (SSE)
- Prompt Caching
- Tool Usage / Function Calling
- Multimodal Vision
- JSON Schema
- Streaming Responses
- API Documentation
- Model Selection
- Anthropic

## Getting Started

- [Claude API Documentation](https://claudeapi.net): Main documentation hub for Claude API featuring Messages endpoint, tool usage, vision capabilities, and streaming responses
